name: neverwolf
summary: This EA is a utility that validates whether a user-selected timeframe input parameter falls within a predefined list of allowed timeframes. If the selected timeframe is invalid, the EA fails initialization and does not proceed. It contains no trading logic whatsoever.
summary_zh: 这个EA是一个工具类程序，用于验证用户选择的时间周期输入参数是否在允许的时间周期列表内。如果所选时间周期无效，EA初始化将失败且不会继续运行。该程序不包含任何交易逻辑。
strategy_analysis: 该EA没有任何交易策略，它纯粹是一个时间周期验证工具。其核心逻辑是在OnInit函数中调用checkTimeframePeriods函数，检查用户输入的Period_TF参数是否属于预定义的允许时间周期列表（M5、M10、M15、M20、M30、H1、H2、H3、H4、H6、H8、H12、D1、W1、MN1）。如果验证不通过，EA返回INIT_FAILED并计划调用ExpertRemove退出，但ExpertRemove放在return之后实际上是死代码，永远不会执行。OnTick和OnDeinit函数均为空，没有任何仓位管理、资金管理或入场出场逻辑。该EA可能设计为其他EA的模板或组件，用于确保时间周期参数的合法性。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA has no trading strategy at all; it is purely a timeframe validation utility. Its core logic calls the checkTimeframePeriods function during OnInit to verify whether the user-provided Period_TF parameter belongs to a predefined list of allowed timeframes (M5, M10, M15, M20, M30, H1, H2, H3, H4, H6, H8, H12, D1, W1, MN1). If validation fails, the EA returns INIT_FAILED and attempts to call ExpertRemove, but ExpertRemove is placed after the return statement, making it unreachable dead code. Both OnTick and OnDeinit functions are empty shells with no position management, money management, or entry/exit logic. The EA appears to be designed as a template or component for other EAs to ensure timeframe parameter validity before proceeding with actual trading logic.

parameters.name: Period_TF
parameters.description: 指标时间周期，用于验证的时间框架参数

pros: 提供了时间周期验证机制，可防止用户输入无效的时间周期参数
允许的时间周期列表覆盖了从M5到MN1的常用周期范围，较为全面
代码结构简单清晰，易于集成到其他EA中作为输入验证模块
pros_en: Provides a timeframe validation mechanism to prevent users from selecting invalid timeframe parameters
The allowed timeframe list covers a comprehensive range from M5 to MN1
Simple and clear code structure, easy to integrate into other EAs as an input validation module
cons: ExpertRemove()调用位于return语句之后，属于死代码，永远不会被执行
缺少有意义的错误提示信息，用户无法知道具体哪个参数未通过验证
OnTick和OnDeinit为空函数，EA本身没有实际功能，仅作为验证框架存在
cons_en: ExpertRemove() call is placed after the return statement, making it dead code that never executes
Lacks meaningful error messages, so users cannot know which specific parameter failed validation
OnTick and OnDeinit are empty functions; the EA has no actual functionality beyond validation
improvements: 将ExpertRemove()移到return语句之前以确保在初始化失败时正确移除EA，并添加Alert提示信息告知用户无效的时间周期
使用INIT_PARAMETERS_INCORRECT代替INIT_FAILED以提供更精确的初始化失败原因区分
improvements_en: Move ExpertRemove() before the return statement to ensure proper EA removal on init failure, and add an Alert message to inform the user of the invalid timeframe
Use INIT_PARAMETERS_INCORRECT instead of INIT_FAILED to provide more precise differentiation of initialization failure reasons

risk_points: ExpertRemove死代码导致初始化失败后EA可能残留而非自动移除
验证失败时缺少用户提示，可能导致用户困惑
risk_points_en: Dead ExpertRemove code may leave the EA resident instead of auto-removing after init failure
Lack of user notification on validation failure may cause confusion
